description: This file contains functions and constants for IPv4 address manipulation, including validation, conversion, and address range checks, used in network configuration scripts.

methods.name: assert_uint32
methods.description: Validates that input is a decimal 32-bit unsigned integer within range.

methods.name: bitcount
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set to 1 in a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: str2ip
methods.description: Converts dotted-quad IP string to 32-bit integer.

methods.name: ip2str
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit integer IP to dotted-quad string.

methods.name: prefix2netmask
methods.description: Converts prefix length to subnet mask in integer form.

methods.name: is_rfc1918
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is within RFC 1918 private ranges.

methods.name: is_rfc3927
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is within RFC 3927 link-local range.

methods.name: is_loopback
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is a loopback address.

methods.name: is_multicast
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is a multicast address.

methods.name: netmask2prefix
methods.description: Converts subnet mask to prefix length, validating contiguity.
